The blogloc map badge is a small map you can embed on your Website to show your live location. Location can be updated over the Web, via mobile phone or directly via GPS on GPS-enabled phones that support Java.
A safe place to store, organize and share your photos. A feature rich social photo sharing platform built with your privacy, data portability and security in mind.
A ghost report community where you can post your true ghost encounter. Find and view other ghost encounters using the Google Maps map. Find similar cases around the world or in your town.

BingAgain is a search engine developed with the aim of providing the BEST relevant results to users. What makes it unique? : You got to see ‘web’, ‘images’, ‘videos’, ‘news’, all results simultaneously in a single page. Not only this, but results (presently web only) are sorted out according to their popularity on “Facebook” which no doubt increases search result quality as well as their relevance.
User driven search where users contribute listings, reviews, pictures, tags, and more. Toronto is first city setup, includes mapped traffic conditions.
Twilio MVC is a vb.net and ASp.Net MVC application demonstrating a welcome message and also the gather call as well as playing mp3 sounds over the line
Tracks leads using a unique telephone number so that customers can be tracked when calling instead of just when they enter information into a website.
Hot videos and popular music via this custom interface on top of YouTube and other sources.

The Google Book Search Book Viewability API enables developers to: Link to Books in Google Book Search using ISBNs, LCCNs, and OCLC numbers; Know whether Google Book Search has a specific title and what the viewability of that title is; Generate links to a thumbnail of the cover of a book; Generate links to an informational page about a book; Generate links to a preview of a book.
